framework.name: Habits of Entrepreneurial Mindset
framework.licenseNotes: Canonical names and definitions are taken from the Habits of Entrepreneurial Mindset document. Confirm usage, attribution, and license before public or branded distribution.
framework.provenance: Ingested from Habits of Entrepreneurial Mindset-2.pdf in the EM-CURE prototype repository. The 3Cs (Curiosity, Connections, Creating Value) are grouping labels; the 18 habits are the selectable items.

items.name: Inquisitiveness
items.definition: Applies curiosity about our continuously changing world.

items.name: Contrarian Thinking
items.definition: Explores alternative or disruptive views of current or accepted solutions.

items.name: Opportunity Seeking
items.definition: Identifies trends and unmet needs to uncover new opportunities.

items.name: Experimentation
items.definition: Constantly experiments and iterates to test new ideas and explore what-ifs.

items.name: Confronting Ambiguity
items.definition: Fearlessly operates with care in complex and uncertain environments.

items.name: Future-Minded
items.definition: Considers emerging trends in people, systems, and environments.

items.name: Creativity
items.definition: Integrates information from disparate sources to spark new ideas.

items.name: Systems Thinking
items.definition: Recognizes interdependencies in systems and identifies leverage points.

items.name: Knowledge Synthesis
items.definition: Combines ideas, information, and experiences to form new understanding.

items.name: Implications Thinking
items.definition: Anticipates the long-term impacts and consequences of actions.

items.name: Strategic Thinking
items.definition: Develops long-term strategies with clear milestones.

items.name: Risk Awareness
items.definition: Proactively incorporates risk management into decision-making.

items.name: Value Awareness
items.definition: Focuses on solutions where extraordinary value can be created.

items.name: Customer-Centric Thinking
items.definition: Frames efforts in terms of stakeholder's actual needs.

items.name: Impact Thinking
items.definition: Seeks outcomes that produce meaningful and scalable benefits for others.

items.name: Socially Minded
items.definition: Prioritizes creating meaningful and positive societal impacts.

items.name: Persistence
items.definition: Maintains a sense of agency and resilience to achieve goals in the face of obstacles and failures.

items.name: Resourcefulness
items.definition: Solves problems creatively with available resources.
